jobs_policies.name: job_events_read
jobs_policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs job
  WHERE (job.id = job_events.job_id)))

jobs_policies.name: jobs_insert
jobs_policies.check: ((NOT eps.jobs_dispatch_mode()) AND (requested_by = auth.uid()) AND eps.jobs_can_access(workspace_id, 'enqueue'::text) AND (status = 'queued'::text) AND (stage = 'prepare_document'::text) AND (attempt = 0) AND (current_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (lease_token_digest IS NULL) AND (dispatch_generation = 1))

jobs_policies.name: jobs_read
jobs_policies.using: (eps.jobs_dispatch_mode() OR eps.jobs_can_access(workspace_id, 'read'::text) OR eps.jobs_can_access(workspace_id, 'enqueue'::text) OR eps.jobs_can_access(workspace_id, 'operate'::text))

jobs_policies.name: jobs_workspace_identity
jobs_policies.using: ((archived_at IS NULL) AND eps.project_scope(project_id, false) AND (eps.has_capability('workspaces.read'::text) OR eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text) OR eps.has_capability('operations.read'::text) OR eps.has_capability('operations.retry'::text)))

jobs_policies.name: outbox_insert
jobs_policies.check:
(eps.jobs_dispatch_mode() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs job
  WHERE ((job.id = outbox_events.job_id) AND (eps.jobs_can_access(job.workspace_id, 'enqueue'::text) OR eps.jobs_can_access(job.workspace_id, 'operate'::text))))))

jobs_policies.name: outbox_read
jobs_policies.using:
(eps.jobs_dispatch_mode() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs job
  WHERE (job.id = outbox_events.job_id))))

policies.name: specs_workspace_identity
policies.using: ((archived_at IS NULL) AND eps.project_scope(project_id, false) AND (eps.has_capability('workspaces.read'::text) OR eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text)))

policies.name: specs_workspace_update
policies.check: ((archived_at IS NULL) AND eps.project_scope(project_id, true) AND eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text))
policies.using: ((archived_at IS NULL) AND eps.project_scope(project_id, true) AND eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text))
